## Hypothesis Info

- **ID:** H-M4
- **Type:** MECHANISM
- **Gate:** SHOULD_WORK
- **Statement:** Under Gao et al. 2023 (arXiv 2210.10760) digitized data (independent dataset, different model scale), if the same regression procedure from H-M3 is applied, then the slope β is again significantly positive (β > 0, p < 0.05), because the calibration-alignment divergence mechanism is a general property of RLHF optimization, not an artifact of Coste et al.'s specific model family.
- **Rationale:** Cross-dataset replication test. H-M3 confirmed the divergence slope in Coste et al. data. H-M4 tests generalizability by applying the identical OLS pipeline to Gao et al. 2023 — a different paper, different model family, different scale (6B RM). Failure scopes the claim to Coste-only but does not invalidate H-BiAlign-v1.

## Variables

- **Independent:** KL budget (continuous predictor, 0–8 nats; Gao et al. Figure 1 x-axis)
- **Dependent:** Calibration-alignment divergence gap = proxy_norm − gold_norm (digitized from Gao et al. Figure 1)
- **Controlled:** Analysis pipeline identical to H-M3 (OLS, bootstrap CI, normalization protocol)

## Experimental Setup

- **Dataset:** Gao et al. 2023 — digitized from arXiv 2210.10760 Figure 1 via WebPlotDigitizer (6B RM size curves); expected N ≈ 8–10 KL-level observations; stored at h-m4/data/gao_2023_gap.csv
- **Model:** OLS linear regression (scipy.stats.linregress + statsmodels) — identical to H-M3; no neural network
- **Task:** Fit gap ~ KL_budget + intercept on Gao et al. data; test H0: β ≤ 0

## Baseline & Comparison

- **Baseline:** H0 (β ≤ 0) — no significant positive relationship in Gao et al. data
- **Proposed:** H1 (β > 0, p < 0.05) in Gao et al. independent dataset
- **Cross-dataset reference:** β_Coste = 0.1433 (H-M3); |β_Gao / β_Coste| ∈ [0.1, 10.0] (secondary criterion)

## Success Criteria

- Primary (gate): β > 0 AND p < 0.05 in Gao et al. data (N ≥ 6)
- Secondary: |β_Gao / β_Coste| ∈ [0.1, 10.0] (within order of magnitude)

## Dependencies & Gate

- Prerequisites: H-M3 (PASS ✓ — β=0.1433, p=8.89e-07, R²=0.9577)
- Gate type: SHOULD_WORK — failure scopes claim to Coste et al. only; does NOT block H-BiAlign-v1 or paper pipeline
- Failure response: Document as replication caveat; continue pipeline with Coste-only evidence
